BYZ_crown_jewels_tt.en: If [THIS.GetCountry.GetName] accept, they will [loan|e] us [SCOPE.GetLocalVariable('loan_size').GetValue|+=] [gold_i|e] and we will suffer from [ShowModifier('BYZ_lacking_jewels')] until the [work_of_art|e] of [target_woa.GetName] is returned

LOAN_TOOLTIP_pawning_of_crown_jewels.en: A mutual agreement has been reached wherein the lender grants a loan to the borrower against the possession of $byzantine_crown_jewels$. When the loan is repaid, the pawned jewels should be returned as well — at least, in theory.

flavor_byz_ven.1.a.en: Desperate times call for equally desperate measures.

flavor_byz_ven.1.desc.en: As the [ShowDisasterName('byzantine_succession_crisis')] rages on, our treasury is being drained, making our position more and more untenable as the conflicts continue. Should our internal turmoil persist, the very existence of the [origin_country.GetLongName] will be in jeopardy.\n\nIn such dire circumstances, a once-unbelievable idea is being floated around — pawning the [target_woa.GetName] as collateral for a loan from one of the merchant republics.

flavor_byz_ven.10.desc.en: Our envoys have returned empty-handed. The [target_country.GetLongName] has refused our offer, unwilling to provide a loan even with the [target_woa.GetName] as collateral. The insult stings almost as much as the blow to our finances. We must seek other means to weather this crisis.

flavor_byz_ven.11.a.en: A bitter loss in a bitter season.

flavor_byz_ven.11.desc.en: Our treasury lies in ruins. Among the obligations made void by our financial collapse is the loan we extended to the [origin_country.GetLongName], with the [target_woa.GetName] as collateral. The contract being annulled, the jewels revert to [origin_country.GetAdjectiveWithNoTooltip] hands, and the leverage we hoped to wield over them slips through our fingers.

flavor_byz_ven.12.a.en: Providence has spared us this indignity.

flavor_byz_ven.12.desc.en: Word has reached the [ROOT.GetCountry.GetGovernment.GetCourtTitle] from the lagoon. The [target_country.GetLongName] has gone bankrupt, their creditors closing in upon what remains of the Serenissima's wealth. In the disarray, the [target_woa.GetName] held by [target_country.GetNameWithNoTooltip] as collateral against our pawning loan have been quietly returned to our possession. The contract is void, and our jewels are once more our own.

flavor_byz_ven.13.a.en: Our honor follows our treasury into the abyss.

flavor_byz_ven.13.desc.en: Our coffers are empty, our debts repudiated. The loan we took from the [target_country.GetLongName] against the [target_woa.GetName] is now in default. By the terms of the agreement, the jewels are forfeit to [target_country.GetNameWithNoTooltip], and word of our shame travels swiftly through the courts of Christendom.

flavor_byz_ven.14.a.en: Their loss is our enduring gain.

flavor_byz_ven.14.desc.en: Distressing tidings reach the [ROOT.GetCountry.GetGovernment.GetCourtTitle] from the [origin_country.GetLongName], who have repudiated their debts and brought ruin upon their treasury. The loan we extended against the [target_woa.GetName] will not be repaid. Yet the collateral is ours by right of the agreement, and it adorns the Serenissima as a prize of our prudence.

flavor_byz_ven.15.a.en: Send envoys to propose a joint pact.

flavor_byz_ven.15.b.en: We will pursue our interests alone.

flavor_byz_ven.15.desc.en: The [GetCountry('GEN').GetAdjective] seizure of [ShowLocationName('chios')] and the neighboring islands from the [GetCountry('BYZ').GetLongName] has greatly worried the merchants of the lagoon. Our [ROOT.GetCountry.GetFlavorRank] cannot tolerate [GetCountry('GEN').GetAdjectiveWithNoTooltip] dominance in the [ShowAreaName('aegean_sea_area')], and the wounded [GetCountry('BYZ').GetAdjectiveWithNoTooltip] state make for the most natural of allies.\n\nShould we extend a hand of friendship to the [GetCountry('BYZ').GetAdjectiveWithNoTooltip] [GetCountry('BYZ').GetGovernment.GetCourtTitle]?

flavor_byz_ven.15.entry.en: An Opportunity against the Genoese Threat

flavor_byz_ven.16.a.en: An old rival becomes a useful ally against a greater foe.

flavor_byz_ven.16.b.en: None of these Latins are of trust.

flavor_byz_ven.16.desc.en: Envoys of the [GetCountry('VEN').GetLongName] approach our [ROOT.GetCountry.GetGovernment.GetCourtTitle] bearing a most welcome proposal, a joint understanding against the [GetCountry('GEN').GetLongName], whose merchant fleets have grown too bold in the [ShowAreaName('aegean_sea_area')] since their seizure of [ShowLocationName('chios')].\n\nThough our recent dealings with [GetCountry('VEN').GetNameWithNoTooltip] have not always been amicable, being both opposed to [GetCountry('GEN').GetAdjectiveWithNoTooltip] ambition makes for an unusual alignment of interests.

flavor_byz_ven.2.a.en: It will make a fine addition to our collection.

flavor_byz_ven.2.desc.en: The [origin_country.GetLongName] is in the most dire of straits. Suffering from the [ShowDisasterName('byzantine_succession_crisis')], they are actively burning through their war chest, and are in critical need of additional funds. Their situation seems so terrible, in fact, that they have made us a most surprising offer: a request for a loan, offering the [target_woa.GetName] as collateral. This may be considered a sign of trust by some... or an act of desperation by others.

flavor_byz_ven.3.a.en: We cannot risk such a mark on our reputation.

flavor_byz_ven.3.b.en: After all, why not? Why should we not keep it?

flavor_byz_ven.3.desc.en: The [origin_country.GetLongName] has just repaid the loan we granted them, and are now demanding that the [target_woa.GetName] be restored to their possession. According to our agreement, we must oblige — but doing so would make us lose what leverage we have on them.\n\nSurely, should we not return the jewels, nothing significant will happen...

flavor_byz_ven.4.desc.en: Per our agreement, we have repaid our loan to the [target_country.GetLongName] and the [target_woa.GetName] was subsequently returned, restored to [origin_country.GetAdjective] possession in [target_location.GetName].\n\nIt was a pleasure doing business with the most serene [ShowGovernmentReformName('merchant_republic')] of all.

flavor_byz_ven.5.a.en: We should not have dealt with the Devil.

flavor_byz_ven.5.desc.en: Despite repaying our loan per the agreement we made, the [target_country.GetAdjective] side has ignored our request to return the [target_woa.GetName]. There is only one way we can interpret this — a grand theft!\n\nThey will face the wrath of the [origin_country.GetLongName]...

flavor_byz_ven.6.desc.en: The [target_army.GetName] has finally returned the [target_woa.GetName] to our possession. Our property has been brought back to [target.GetName], where it was warmly received by the [ROOT.GetCountry.GetGovernment.GetCourtTitle]. No longer can our enemies use these jewels to leverage their will upon us!

flavor_byz_ven.6.desc_recovered.en: The [target_woa.GetName] are once more in our possession, recovered along with [target.GetName]. Our property has been brought back to where it belongs, warmly received by the [ROOT.GetCountry.GetGovernment.GetCourtTitle]. No longer can our enemies use these jewels to leverage their will upon us!

flavor_byz_ven.7.a.en: We shall return them to our dear allies.

flavor_byz_ven.7.b.en: But it is rightfully ours by theft!

flavor_byz_ven.7.desc.en: The recent takeover of [location.GetName] has been a great success for [ROOT.GetCountry.GetName]. Our forces, [target_army.GetName], have conducted a comprehensive 'survey' of the land, acquiring the [target_woa.GetName] in the process, an important asset to our allies in [origin_country.GetName]. We could return it to them... but do we not deserve an equal share of the spoils of war?

flavor_byz_ven.8.a.en: Is there anything they can do right, besides hoarding gold?

flavor_byz_ven.8.desc.en: Reports have reached us of our lenders' utter incompetence! Having loaned us gold with the venerable [target_woa.GetName] as collateral, they have managed to get those same jewels stolen right from under their noses. We devoutly hope they will recover our goods. If not, we will have to take them back them from [target.GetName] ourselves...

flavor_byz_ven.9.desc.en: Our envoys have returned from [target_country.GetName] with most welcome news: the [target_country.GetAdjective] merchants have agreed to our offer. In exchange for the [target_woa.GetName], a loan has been extended to us, giving our treasury the breathing room it so desperately needed. Let us make the most of this reprieve.
